info.title: Aseman public API
info.description: Generated from the A402 action registry by `scripts/generate_public_api.py`; do not edit by hand. Every operation here is one registered action, so nothing is reachable that is not authorizable. The legacy TCP and WebSocket transports carry these same actions and contain framing only.

session.name: Aseman-Session
session.description: A session identifier. It is a bearer credential and is never mapped or logged.

proof.name: Aseman-Proof
proof.description: An A401 signed request proof, for a workload or a node.

aseman_reason.description: The stable refusal reason, for a client to branch on.
